verdict.rationale: The pack shows version-scoped documentation (the 4.27 and 5.8 doc pages, a Python API reference labeled 5.8/Experimental), Experimental/Beta maturity banners, and a public roadmap. None of these documents API versioning guarantees or a deprecation policy, so they are adjacent signals that earn no credit toward this story. One community comment that upgrades break things does not supply such a policy either.
